2608.29662.title: ACTD: Anchor-Based Cross-Tokenizer Distillation with Residual Regularization
2608.29662.paper_summary: Knowledge distillation effectively transfers reasoning capabilities from large language models to lightweight student models. To enable knowledge transfer across disparate model families, researchers increasingly explore cross-tokenizer distillation. However, cross-tokenizer distillation remains challenging due to vocabulary and sequence misalignment, while approximate vocabulary alignment can introduce additional noise into distillation. To address these challenges, we propose Anchor-Based Cross-Tokenizer Distillation with Residual Regularization (ACTD). ACTD bridges structural heterogeneity through vocabulary and sequence alignment, while mitigating alignment noise via a novel anchor loss with residual regularization. We further extend this framework to a multi-teacher setting. Evaluated across five reasoning benchmarks with three distinct teacher models, ACTD achieves state-of-the-art performance. Moreover, its multi-teacher extension outperforms the strongest single-teacher and multi-teacher baselines, further demonstrating the robustness of our method.
2608.29662.paper_summary_zh: 知識蒸餾有效地將推理能力從大型語言模型轉移到輕量級學生模型。為了實現跨不同模型家族的知識轉移，研究人員越來越多地探索跨標記器蒸餾。然而，由於詞彙和序列的不對齊，跨標記器蒸餾仍然具有挑戰性，而近似的詞彙對齊可能會在蒸餾中引入額外的噪聲。為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了基於錨點的跨標記器蒸餾與殘差正則化（ACTD）。ACTD通過詞彙和序列對齊來橋接結構異質性，同時通過一種新穎的錨點損失和殘差正則化來減輕對齊噪聲。我們進一步將這一框架擴展到多教師設置。在五個推理基準上評估，使用三個不同的教師模型，ACTD達到了最先進的性能。此外，其多教師擴展超越了最強的單教師和多教師基準，進一步證明了我們方法的穩健性。
